title: [tenmin-range-entries] dateFromDaysSinceEpoch: characterization test for the UTC date of a day number
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceSTOCKS

add a characterization test for dateFromDaysSinceEpoch in src/tenmin-range-entries.ts: utc day numbers
- dateFromDaysSinceEpoch(0) is "1970-01-01"
- dateFromDaysSinceEpoch(20454) is "2026-01-01"
- dateFromDaysSinceEpoch(-1) throws INVALID_RANGE
- dateFromDaysSinceEpoch(1.5) throws INVALID_RANGE

(Builder pre-file, TEST_CASE_EXISTING, public-test-case-existing-v1): Peace's task (source: peace). The day-number to YYYY-MM-DD conversion used by the range entries (and its INVALID_RANGE guard) has no test; this pins its current behaviour. Production safety: test-only: one new src/*.test.ts file only: no source edits, no fix commit. Job B grades it fix-free: the test passes on the current code and fails with the function body stubbed. The running scanner chain is unchanged. A box dry-run on PeaceSTOCKS 47cfaaf built exactly one candidate (public-test-case-existing-v1); a local Job B run graded it COUNTS (the new test passes on the current code and fails with dateFromDaysSinceEpoch stubbed); suite 556/556 with all six new tests of this batch, all 4 typechecks ok. Disjoint file: each task in this batch creates its own new test file. Expected COUNTS.)
